title: In-Memory Room Store and Room Service
externalChecks: Gate E real-device unsynchronized drift calibration remains EXTERNAL VALIDATION PENDING and does not block this store/service gate
instructions: Implement only the room-store abstraction, single-process in-memory adapter, and room domain service. Do not add HTTP endpoints or Socket.IO handlers yet.
The service must resolve an existing participant by clientId before enforcing the two-person capacity limit, so a refresh/reconnect in a full room cannot be rejected as a third participant.
Room creation must initialize one paused authoritative timeline at media time zero using INITIAL_ROOM_EPOCH and INITIAL_TIMELINE_SEQ and fence it to the exact movie assetId/assetVersion.
Generate roomId and participantId with cryptographically strong server-side randomness; do not use counters or timestamps.
Keep persistence behind WatchRoomStore. No Redis or database implementation in this gate.
The in-memory adapter's updateRoom must make each updater application atomic within the single Node process and must not expose internal mutable room objects to callers.
Include short-lived processed-command storage in the store seam for later idempotency, but do not implement playback command handling in this gate.
Do not add disconnect-grace timers, socket identity, chat, clock sync, player sync, buffering policy, or UI changes.
A task is not complete until pnpm watch:gate exits 0 and the GitHub Watch Together Gate is green.
After Gate G passes, stop. Do not begin Gate H Socket.IO lifecycle work in the same branch.
